## Summary

<!-- Explain what changed and why. Link issues with "Closes #123" when appropriate. -->

## Type of change

- [ ] `fix`: backward-compatible bug fix
- [ ] `feat`: backward-compatible feature
- [ ] Breaking change (`!` or `BREAKING CHANGE:` footer)
- [ ] Documentation, refactor, test, build, CI, or maintenance change

## Verification

<!-- List exact commands and relevant manual scenarios. -->

- [ ] `./scripts/check.sh`
- [ ] New or changed behavior has automated tests
- [ ] Terminal UI was checked at `64x24` and a larger size when layout changed

## Documentation and release

- [ ] Relevant supported-language documents are updated or marked for language review
- [ ] The PR title follows Conventional Commits and describes one logical change
- [ ] User-visible changes are suitable for the generated changelog

## Safety

- [ ] No secrets, personal data, generated build outputs, or unrelated changes are included
- [ ] Persistence format changes remain backward compatible or include a migration
